narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To show how low support for legalizing marijuana was in 1969, when Gallup first asked the question.

units.meaning: The data point is anchored to the year 1969, when Gallup first asked the question.
accepted_routes: Gallup's 1969 measurement is the starting point
units.visual_evidence_rule: The year 1969 must be visible as the time anchor for the data point.
units.reviewer_question: Must the clip label 1969 as the baseline year?

units.meaning: In 1969, 12% of respondents favored legalizing marijuana.
accepted_routes: just 12 percent supported legalizing marijuana in 1969
units.visual_evidence_rule: The 1969 legalization share must be displayed or labeled as 12%.
units.temporal_anchor: when Gallup first asked the question and found that just 12% favor legalizing marijuana use
units.reviewer_question: Is the exact 1969 value of 12% required, or is a rounded approximation acceptable?

optional_valid: The clip may say opinions have changed drastically since 1969 without giving a present-day number.
The clip may mention that 1969 was when Gallup first asked the question.
unsupported_to_avoid: Any present-day legalization percentage, such as the 52%/45% split that belongs to another clip.
Why 1969 matters, or any causal explanation for the opinion shift.
Any change amount or growth rate from 1969 to the present, since the table has only the 1969 row.
Chart-type, axis, color, or position prescriptions.
notes: 旁白首句（"…compared with 45% who want it to be illegal"）已删除，它是 2019 年民调的半句，与本 clip 只有 1969 年数据不符。intent 随之从"从 1969 到现在的转变"改成"1969 年的支持率有多低"。
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only

trim.reason: 人工逐条指定：删除/合并
